title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About the Role 
 BusRight builds routing and transportation software that helps school districts get students to school and home safely. As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll own a book of districts and be responsible for one thing above all: making sure every one of them gets real, measurable results from BusRight and wants to keep working with us year after year.
 You’ll be the person each district trusts most at BusRight . You’ll learn their goals, build a success plan with them, track progress against it, and show them the return they’re getting. When a district starts to struggle, you’ll see it early and do something about it. Our Support team owns tickets and our Implementation team owns onboarding and setup, so your time goes where it matters most, with your customers.
 What You’ll Do 
 Build and own a success plan for every district in your book. Sit down with district leaders, understand what they’re trying to accomplish, set goals together, and review progress and ROI with them on a regular cadence.
 Drive adoption across the platform. Know which parts of BusRight each district is using and which they aren’t, close training gaps (especially after staff turnover), and help them get more out of the product every year.
 Own retention for your book. Every district renews every year, so you’ll lead the value conversation first and the renewal conversation after, starting four to six months ahead of the renewal date.
 Spot risk early and act on it. Watch health, usage and sentiment, flag at-risk accounts, and build and run recovery plans that get them back to healthy.
 Build relationships at every level of the district. You’ll join the implementation kickoff for new districts and get to know superintendents, business officials and transportation directors from day one, then keep those relationships strong with consistent, scheduled engagement.
 Find growth opportunities. When a district’s needs grow, you’ll spot it and partner with our Sales team to bring the right solution forward.
 Be the voice of the customer inside BusRight . Share what you’re hearing with Product, Support and Implementation so we keep getting better for districts.
 What You’ll Bring 
 3 to 5 years of experience as a Customer Success Manager at a SaaS company, managing your own book of business
 EdTech or K-12 experience is a big plus. If you’ve worked with school districts before, you already know how they make decisions, how budgets work and what the school year feels like, and that matters here.
 A track record of retaining customers and driving adoption, with results you can walk us through
 Experience building success plans and leading business reviews or ROI conversations with executive stakeholders
 Strong organization and a habit of using data to decide where to spend your time
 Comfort working in Salesforce and a customer success platform
 Steadiness under pressure. Back to school (July through September) is our busiest season, and districts count on us to show up.
 Ability to travel up to 15% of the time
 Who Thrives Here
 You believe in Magical Hospitality, one of the values our team holds closest. For us, being responsive and kind is only the starting point. You anticipate what a district needs
 before they ask, follow through on the little things, and make every person you work with feel like they’re your only customer.
 You take ownership of your accounts and don’t wait for someone else to fix a problem.
 You’re proactive. You’d rather pick up the phone and call a district than wait for them to call you.
 You lead with curiosity, ask good questions and bring a point of view.
 You like building things. We’re growing quickly and putting new processes in place, and you’ll help shape how Customer Success works here.
 You see feedback as a gift and keep getting better.
 Why BusRight 
 Your work directly affects whether students get to school safely and on time.
 You’ll join a Customer Success team that’s growing and investing in how we work, from success plans to new playbooks and tools.
 Remote work with a culture built on trust and collaboration
